dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent circular annuli in the mid-to-posterior region exhibit sharp pixel intensity gradients from dark to light perimeters. The most central structure is a closed 'O' with a non-uniform perimeter width. A 'C' shaped structure located dorsally to the center shows a distinct opening on its ventral-facing edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients are scattered dorsally. These blobs appear as localized points of high luminance compared to the surrounding dark pelt.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the central-most annulus and two adjacent posterior annuli form a scalene triangle. The spatial distance between the central and dorsal-most centroids is approximately 1.5 times the distance between the central and posterior-most centroids.

other_distinctive_markers: The anterior region displays a dense, interconnected mesh of partial annuli, creating a complex polygonal or 'honeycomb' topology distinct from the more isolated rings elsewhere.
